title: Data plane kind: flow dir: down
ext: HTTP clients | the data-plane listener @gray
[Data plane] blue edge: Edge | TLS, limits route: Route to? | Function, Site or Lake [Inside funcd] gray int: Callers | links, steps, Sensors, hooks [/] chain: Invoke chain | Admit, Before, After act: Activator | wakes a worker exec: Executor | runs the workers site: Site files | from a Bucket lake: Lake gateway | its queries [/]
ext > edge > route route > chain: a Function route > site route > lake int > chain chain > act > exec
